title: Fighter Equipment Token Master
description: Fighter Equipment Token Master — The Townstons wiki
html:
Fighter Equip Token Master


The Fighter Master in the north section of Townston offers players a chance to trade Kings Coins for yellow items in their class. Each item is randomly drawn from a category a player chooses. The categories available are Fighter Rings, Fighter Amulets, Fighter armor, Shoulder armor, One-Handed and Two-handed Fighter Weapon which is always a ranged missile weapon, Fighter gloves and Fighter boots. The price varies based on which type of armor you select, but it's never more than 6 coins.

There is a small chance that she will give purple items instead of yellow. Items sold are immediately soulbound to the buyer. Gives yellow items in exchange for Kings Coins. There is a small chance that he will give purple items instead of yellow
